svg.title: The app calls one agent
svg.desc: The intended native runtime route is a signed-in user in a Managed Runtime app calling a published standard-harness Copilot Studio agent through its generated ExecuteCopilotAsyncV2 service. The agent's Invoker-mode Fabric IQ tool reads the bound ontology as that user; its Invoker-mode Foundry IQ tool retrieves document evidence through that user's Search connection. Agent readers access and disabled generic grounding are required. Responses and follow-up messages stay in the same user's conversation. Prove the connection challenge, live answer, follow-up and second-user denial/isolation separately; hosted deployment is also separate. The connector has a 120-second limit. The Foundry Agent Service connector is a different, currently blocked Managed Runtime route.

g.text: Every hop preserves the signed-in user; IQ tools use personal connections.
Sign in and choose your own connections.
Deployment consent is a different boundary.
Answers return through the same agent and conversation.
Invoker mode on both IQ tools.
Never replace denied live facts with files.
Prove denial + isolation with a second user.
Hosted deployment is a separate approval.
120-second connector limit: cold ontology queries can time out.
Foundry Agent Service is a separate, currently blocked app route, not the path shown here.
